content_md:
## What Is Dynamic Mockups?

Dynamic Mockups is a mockup generation platform for POD sellers and e-commerce brands. Generate photorealistic product mockups from 10000+ templates or custom PSD files with AI-powered mockup and video generation. Includes a RESTful API for automated workflows.

## Key Features for Print Shops and POD Sellers

### 10000+ Templates
Industry's largest mockup template library covering apparel accessories packaging print devices.

### REST API with SDKs
10+ endpoint API with JavaScript Python Laravel and Rails SDKs. Rate limit 300 calls/min. Auth via x-api-key.

### AI-Powered Generation
AI mockup generator and AI video mockup generation for dynamic product presentations.

### Integrations
Shopify Etsy Make.com Zapier and embeddable iFrame editor.

## Pricing

| Plan | Price | Credits | Details |
|------|-------|---------|---------|
| Free | $0 | 50 credits + daily free AI | Watermark-free exports |
| Pro | $15/mo (annual) | 3600/yr ($0.051/credit) | Tiers up to 60000/yr |
| Enterprise | Custom | 5000+/mo | White-label SLA |

## Verdict

Use it if: You need API-driven bulk mockup generation or have 100+ SKUs to mock up regularly.

Skip it if: You need async webhook workflows or can't work within the credit system.
